fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Each yes goes to Dr. Esterly before the visit

Every patient at Cordova Skin Clinic answers the health questions written by its medical director, Dr. Theo Esterly. Lisette Hartwell fills in her form on Sunday and answers yes to the medicines question. Dr. Esterly gets an email with her answer at the top, 2 days before her Tuesday appointment.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { injectorTreatmentNotes: "I run Saffron Hill Aesthetics. Build a botox consent form patients e-sign before the visit. After the treatment, let the injector open the same record and add the product, the lot number, and the areas treated, such as forehead lines and crow's feet. Give me a search by lot number that lists every patient treated from that lot.", beforeAndAfterPhotos: "My skin studio takes before and after photos at every visit. Build a photo consent question with two choices: chart only, or chart and marketing. Tag every photo saved to the patient record with that choice, and give my marketing team a gallery that shows only photos tagged for marketing.", medicalDirectorReview: "Our medical director writes the health questions on our botox consent form. Make each one a yes or no field with a box for details. When a patient answers yes to any of them, email the medical director with that answer at the top, 2 days before the appointment.", updatedConsentWording: "We just changed our consent wording to version 4. Build a consent form that records which version each patient signed. Returning patients who signed version 3 should get the new wording with their next booking reminder. Keep the old signature on the record, and show me how many have signed version 4 so far." };
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-7-des: Fill in the form twice yourself, once as a new patient who answers yes to a health question and once as a returning patient on the old wording. Check that the medical director gets the email and the new version appears, then open both records.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a botox consent form that saves every response to a database I own.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Lisette Hartwell answers yes to the medicines question on her Sunday form at Cordova Skin Clinic, and medical director Dr. Theo Esterly gets an email with that answer first, 2 days before her Tuesday appointment.
